name: howto
title: Set up a doorbell that never needs a plan
sub: Do these before the free trial ends
footer: From the makers' install and support pages and owner forum threads, read November 11, 2026.

items.head: Read the transformer
items.body: eufy wants 16 to 24 V AC at 30 VA for wired mode; under 10 VA owners report drain and missed rings.

items.head: Pick the storage
items.body: An endurance microSD for Reolink, Aqara or Tapo; eufy's 8 GB is built in.

items.head: Format the card
items.body: Format it in the app on day one and check a test clip plays back.

items.head: Shrink the zone
items.body: Cut the street out of the motion zone; it is the top battery drain owners name.

items.head: Turn off what you skip
items.body: On Ring, turn off Search Party per camera in Control Center.

items.head: Check after updates
items.body: Owners on eufy and Aqara report firmware that broke chimes or batteries.
